The '''J-77 "Event Horizon" sublight engine''' was a small yet powerful [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] unit that was manufactured by [[Novaldex/Legends|Novaldex]], and used in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]. The engines relied on adjustable [[thrust-vector control]]s and [[thruster-control jet]]s for enhanced maneuverability and performances.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

But even with that, the craft is nearly impossible to regain a stable flight even from some of the best pilots in the galaxy, as seen when [[Arvel Crynyd/Legends|Arvel Crynyd]], a lone A-wing pilot, lost control of his craft and crashed in to the [[Executor/Legends|Executor's]] bridge during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

They were apparently fairly volatile, as demonstrated by [[Vergere]] at [[Battle of Ebaq|Ebaq Nine]].
